-- nilelem/go.mod --
module example.com/nilelem

go 1.27

-- nilelem/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

var _ time.Duration

const c = []*time.Duration{nil}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(len(c))
}

-- nilarray/go.mod --
module example.com/nilarray

go 1.27

-- nilarray/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

var _ time.Duration

const c = [1]*int{nil}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(len(c))
}
